# Teaching checklist

### Room and presentation setup

- [ ] Arrive early and switch on the room equipment.
- [ ] On the room's control panel, select **Share content, Desktop**.
- [ ] Windows: `Win`+`p`, Erweitert, duplizieren (to show IDE as well)
- [ ] Check that the presentation appears correctly on the projector.
- [ ] Open the course slides and required exercise files.
- [ ] If technical problems persist, contact **Frankfurt School IT Support**:
  - **Phone:** [+49 69 154008-111](tel:+4969154008111)
  - **Email:** [111@fs.de](mailto:111@fs.de)

### Student setup and technical issues

- [ ] Verify that the student can access Canvas and the course resources.
- [ ] Distinguish course/setup questions from institutional IT problems.
- [ ] Point the student to the appropriate resource below.

- [ ] Refer the student to the appropriate professional service below.
- [ ] Do not independently assess disabilities or promise accommodations.

| --------------------------------- | :--: |
